request.style: English, gravelly male solo voice, electric guitar, upright bass, piano, Hammond organ, drums, solemn and urgent, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Son of man I speak to you
I made you a watchman true
For the house of Israel now
Hear my word and let it show

[Verse]
To the wicked I have said
You will surely die instead
If you stay silent in the dark
His blood is on your mark

[Chorus]
Warn them now before they fall
Speak the word to stand them tall
If they refuse to turn away
Their guilt remains for always

[Verse]
If you warn and they do not change
The wicked path is their range
They die in guilt before your eyes
But you have saved your life

[Chorus]
Warn them now before they fall
Speak the word to stand them tall
If they refuse to turn away
Their guilt remains for always

[Bridge]
Even righteous may turn aside
Place a stumbling block to hide
If you fail to warn the just
Their good deeds are turned to dust

[Outro]
Warn the righteous not to sin
He lives because he did listen
You have saved your own life
